mapper.select: SELECT R.ID AS id, R.ROOM_NUM AS roomNum, R.TYPE_ID AS typeId, R.FLOOR AS floor, R.STATUS AS status, R.MEMO AS memo, RT.NAME AS typeName, C.NAME AS guestName FROM ROOM R JOIN ROOM_TYPE RT ON R.TYPE_ID = RT.ID LEFT JOIN CHECKIN_STATUS CS ON R.ID = CS.ROOM_ID AND CS.CHECKIN IS NOT NULL AND CS.CHECKOUT IS NULL LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER C ON CS.GUEST_ID = C.ID ORDER BY R.FLOOR DESC, R.ROOM_NUM ASC

SELECT R.ID AS id, R.ROOM_NUM AS roomNum, R.TYPE_ID AS typeId, R.FLOOR AS floor, R.STATUS AS status, R.MEMO AS memo, RT.NAME AS typeName, C.NAME AS guestName, RS.GUEST_COUNT AS guestCount, CS.CHECKIN AS checkinTime, RS.CHECKOUT AS checkoutTime FROM ROOM R JOIN ROOM_TYPE RT ON R.TYPE_ID = RT.ID LEFT JOIN CHECKIN_STATUS CS ON R.ID = CS.ROOM_ID AND CS.CHECKIN IS NOT NULL AND CS.CHECKOUT IS NULL LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER C ON CS.GUEST_ID = C.ID LEFT JOIN RESERVATION RS ON CS.RESERVATION_ID = RS.ID WHERE R.ID = #{roomId}

SELECT R.ID AS id, R.ROOM_NUM AS roomNum, R.TYPE_ID AS typeId, R.FLOOR AS floor, R.STATUS AS status, R.MEMO AS memo, RT.NAME AS typeName, C.NAME AS guestName FROM ROOM R JOIN ROOM_TYPE RT ON R.TYPE_ID = RT.ID LEFT JOIN CHECKIN_STATUS CS ON R.ID = CS.ROOM_ID AND CS.CHECKIN IS NOT NULL AND CS.CHECKOUT IS NULL LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER C ON CS.GUEST_ID = C.ID WHERE FLOOR = #{floor} ORDER BY R.ROOM_NUM ASC
SELECT ID AS id, ROOM_NUM AS roomNum FROM ROOM WHERE TYPE_ID = #{roomTypeId} AND STATUS = '이용가능' ORDER BY FLOOR DESC, ROOM_NUM ASC
